findings.title: Receipt guard enforces only the USD ceiling; a receipt reporting model calls above max_model_calls is accepted and ledgered
findings.failure_scenario: _checked claims a receipt is accepted only if it 'spent nothing beyond the proposer's ceiling', but it compares expenditure.usd only. The proposer's other ceiling, max_model_calls, is applied to the input and never verified on the output. A non-conforming cortex is the threat model this guard exists for, as the claims_authority, tampered and spent tests show. Such a cortex can return a well-formed, re-digested receipt with expenditure.model_calls=50 to a proposer configured with max_model_calls=0. The receipt is ledgered and a draft.prepare candidate is returned, while the runtime charged one call. (A NaN usd is refused by canonical JSON, so that variant is not a bypass.)
